mapper.select:
SELECT schedule.* FROM self_media_publish_schedule schedule JOIN browser_environment environment ON environment.id = schedule.browser_environment_id AND environment.brand_id = schedule.brand_id JOIN browser_environment_agent_binding agent_binding ON agent_binding.browser_environment_id = environment.id JOIN local_agent_runtime_status helper_runtime ON helper_runtime.machine_id = agent_binding.machine_id AND helper_runtime.active_profile = agent_binding.active_profile AND helper_runtime.session_id = #{localAgentSessionId} JOIN local_agent_session helper_session ON helper_session.id = helper_runtime.session_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY schedule.queue_priority ASC, COALESCE(schedule.next_attempt_at, schedule.platform_scheduled_at, schedule.planned_publish_at), schedule.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM browser_environment environment JOIN browser_environment_agent_binding agent_binding ON agent_binding.browser_environment_id = environment.id JOIN local_agent_runtime_status helper_runtime ON helper_runtime.machine_id = agent_binding.machine_id AND helper_runtime.active_profile = agent_binding.active_profile AND helper_runtime.session_id = #{localAgentSessionId} JOIN local_agent_session helper_session ON helper_session.id = helper_runtime.session_id WHERE environment.id = #{browserEnvironmentId} AND environment.brand_id = #{brandId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schedule.id) FROM self_media_publish_schedule schedule JOIN browser_environment environment ON environment.id = schedule.browser_environment_id AND environment.brand_id = schedule.brand_id JOIN browser_environment_agent_binding agent_binding ON agent_binding.browser_environment_id = environment.id JOIN local_agent_runtime_status helper_runtime ON helper_runtime.machine_id = agent_binding.machine_id AND helper_runtime.active_profile = agent_binding.active_profile AND helper_runtime.session_id = #{localAgentSessionId} JOIN local_agent_session helper_session ON helper_session.id = helper_runtime.session_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT COUNT(1) AS dueCount, COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM browser_environment environment WHERE environment.id = schedule.browser_environment_id AND environment.brand_id = schedule.brand_id AND environment.status = 'active' AND environment.deleted_at IS NULL )), 0) AS activeEnvironmentCount, COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM browser_environment environment JOIN browser_environment_agent_binding agent_binding ON agent_binding.browser_environment_id = environment.id AND agent_binding.status = 'active' WHERE environment.id = schedule.browser_environment_id AND environment.brand_id = schedule.brand_id AND environment.status = 'active' AND environment.deleted_at IS NULL )), 0) AS anyBindingCount, COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM browser_environment environment JOIN browser_environment_agent_binding agent_binding ON agent_binding.browser_environment_id = environment.id AND agent_binding.status = 'active' AND agent_binding.bound_by = #{operatorId} WHERE environment.id = schedule.browser_environment_id AND environment.brand_id = schedule.brand_id AND environment.status = 'active' AND environment.deleted_at IS NULL )), 0) AS operatorBindingCount, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM local_agent_runtime_status helper_runtime JOIN local_agent_session helper_session ON helper_session.id = helper_runtime.session_id AND helper_session.operator_id = #{operatorId} AND helper_session.status = 'active' AND helper_session.expires_at > #{now} WHERE helper_runtime.session_id = #{localAgentSessionId} AND helper_runtime.operator_id = #{operatorId} ) AS helperRuntimeCount, COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM browser_environment environment JOIN browser_environment_agent_binding agent_binding ON agent_binding.browser_environment_id = environment.id AND agent_binding.status = 'active' AND agent_binding.bound_by = #{operatorId} JOIN local_agent_runtime_status helper_runtime ON helper_runtime.machine_id = agent_binding.machine_id AND helper_runtime.active_profile = agent_binding.active_profile AND helper_runtime.session_id = #{localAgentSessionId} AND helper_runtime.operator_id = #{operatorId} JOIN local_agent_session helper_session ON helper_session.id = helper_runtime.session_id AND helper_session.operator_id = #{operatorId} AND helper_session.status = 'active' AND helper_session.expires_at > #{now} AND (helper_session.brand_id IS NULL OR helper_session.brand_id = environment.brand_id) WHERE environment.id = schedule.browser_environment_id AND environment.brand_id = schedule.brand_id AND environment.status = 'active' AND environment.deleted_at IS NULL )), 0) AS localAgentBindingCount FROM self_media_publish_schedule schedule WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(scoped.capacity), 0) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT helper_runtime.id, GREATEST(helper_runtime.capacity, 0) AS capacity FROM local_agent_runtime_status helper_runtime JOIN local_agent_session helper_session ON helper_session.id = helper_runtime.session_id AND helper_session.operator_id = helper_runtime.operator_id AND helper_session.status = 'active' AND helper_session.expires_at > #{now} AND helper_session.last_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND helper_session.last_seen_at >= #{onlineSince} JOIN browser_environment_agent_binding agent_binding ON agent_binding.machine_id = helper_runtime.machine_id AND agent_binding.active_profile = helper_runtime.active_profile AND agent_binding.status = 'active' AND agent_binding.bound_by = helper_session.operator_id JOIN browser_environment environment ON environment.id = agent_binding.browser_environment_id AND environment.brand_id = #{brandId} AND environment.status = 'active' AND environment.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE helper_runtime.last_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND helper_runtime.last_seen_at >= #{onlineSince} AND (helper_session.brand_id IS NULL OR helper_session.brand_id = environment.brand_id) ) scoped

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT helper_runtime.id) FROM local_agent_runtime_status helper_runtime JOIN local_agent_session helper_session ON helper_session.id = helper_runtime.session_id AND helper_session.operator_id = helper_runtime.operator_id AND helper_session.status = 'active' AND helper_session.expires_at > #{now} AND helper_session.last_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND helper_session.last_seen_at >= #{onlineSince} JOIN browser_environment_agent_binding agent_binding ON agent_binding.machine_id = helper_runtime.machine_id AND agent_binding.active_profile = helper_runtime.active_profile AND agent_binding.status = 'active' AND agent_binding.bound_by = helper_session.operator_id JOIN browser_environment environment ON environment.id = agent_binding.browser_environment_id AND environment.brand_id = #{brandId} AND environment.status = 'active' AND environment.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE helper_runtime.last_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND helper_runtime.last_seen_at >= #{onlineSince} AND (helper_session.brand_id IS NULL OR helper_session.brand_id = environment.brand_id)
